name: Bloomerang
description: Bloomerang is a nonprofit CRM and fundraising platform for constituent relationships, donations, campaigns, appeals, interactions, communications, events and volunteer management.
agentUseSummary: Bloomerang is visible as an OAuth-registration security preview. Relay will not collect the administrator private key that Bloomerang documents as able to change any information.

capabilities.label: Access authorized fundraising CRM data
capabilities.description: After Bloomerang registers and approves Relay's OAuth application, expose only reviewed capabilities within the consenting database authority.

blocked.label: Collect the administrator private key
blocked.description: Bloomerang states that its REST private key allows anyone holding it to change any information; Relay will not use it for a third-party integration.

blocked.label: Connect before OAuth registration
blocked.description: Relay has not registered and received approval for a Bloomerang third-party OAuth application.

blocked.label: Expose people and financial data before review
blocked.description: Constituents, households, transactions, designations, addresses, notes, interactions and payment data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Run agent actions before contract review
blocked.description: No CRM, fundraising, communication, event, volunteer, mutation, webhook or raw API action is callable before OAuth and field-level review.

approvalProfiles.label: OAuth registration required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable; Relay rejects the all-powerful private key and awaits an approved OAuth application contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Bloomerang approves Relay's third-party OAuth application.
No Hermes tools are callable until Bloomerang approves Relay's third-party OAuth application.

providerSetup.blocker: Bloomerang documents a server private key that can change any information and explicitly recommends OAuth registration when a third party receives access; Relay has no approved OAuth application contract yet.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register Relay through Bloomerang's official OAuth application process and obtain written production approval. Review tenant binding, grants, token lifecycle, permissions, rate limits, webhook signing, read/write separation and sensitive field handling before implementing tools.

evidence.supports: Bloomerang documents its REST API as server-to-server, warns that the private key lets anyone change any information, and recommends OAuth registration when allowing a third party access.
Bloomerang's official changelog documents its current API generation and a v3 OAuth overhaul that required earlier OAuth users to reauthorize.
Bloomerang describes its Open API as a custom-integration surface for nonprofit CRM data, which includes sensitive constituent and fundraising records.
